## Differential peaks
```{r}
plan(multisession(workers = 4))
```

### Glut vs. GABA
```{r}
# Group all Glut-* clusters vs all GABA-* clusters
proj$BroadClass <- ifelse(
  grepl("^Glut", proj$cluster) & !grepl("Pre-1|Pre-2", proj$cluster), "Glut",
  ifelse(grepl("^GABA", proj$cluster), "GABA", "other")
)

markersPeaks <- getMarkerFeatures(
  ArchRProj  = proj,
  useMatrix  = "PeakMatrix",
  groupBy    = "BroadClass",
  testMethod = "wilcoxon",
  bias       = c("TSSEnrichment", "log10(nFrags)"),
)

# Extract Glut-enriched peaks (high in Glut, low in GABA)
glut_markers <- getMarkers(markersPeaks, cutOff = "FDR <= 0.1 & Log2FC >= 1",
                            returnGR = TRUE)$Glut

export(glut_markers, out_bed_fname, format = "BED")

```
